archetype: Archetype 6 (Vibrant Play) combined with Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy)

typography.strategy: Use Fredoka for soft/chibi UI elements (health, scrap). Use Anton for high-impact Metal Slug moments (Title, GAME OVER, LEVEL START). Use Nunito for readable controls/menus.

layout_spacing.philosophy: Centralized focal point. The 1280x720 game canvas is the hero. Generous external padding, tight HUD internal padding.
layout_spacing.canvas_container: max-w-[1280px] w-full aspect-video mx-auto relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl ring-4 ring-white/10 shadow-[0_0_60px_rgba(0,0,0,0.7)] bg-black

HUD_Overlay.strategy: Absolute positioning over the canvas (`absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none`). Use `flex justify-between items-start p-6`. Elements must have `pointer-events-auto` if interactive.
HUD_Overlay.sticker_health: Row of heart icons (use Phosphor Heart with fill). Use `text-primary_accent bg-white rounded-full border-4 border-sticker_outline shadow-[0_4px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)]`. Animate missing health by dropping opacity to 30% and grayscale.
HUD_Overlay.scrap_meter: Chunky progress bar. `h-8 w-48 rounded-full bg-black/60 border-4 border-sticker_outline p-1 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center`. Inner bar `bg-secondary_accent rounded-full h-full w-3/4`.
HUD_Overlay.power_timer: Circular badge `w-16 h-16 rounded-full border-4 border-sticker_outline bg-energy_accent flex items-center justify-center font-impact text-2xl text-white shadow-[0_4px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)]`.
HUD_Overlay.coins: Yellow coin icon next to a chunky number (e.g. `x 42`) with text-shadow for readability.

Title_Screen.strategy: Overlay covering the canvas. Use the `game_world_bg` with a `bg-black/40` overlay. Character art positioned on the right, massive typography on the left.
Title_Screen.title_text: Hyper Axel. Use `font-impact text-[8rem] leading-none text-white drop-shadow-[0_8px_0_#FF3B30]` (Metal Slug influence).
Title_Screen.start_button: Tactile bouncy button. `bg-primary_accent text-white font-heading text-3xl px-12 py-4 rounded-xl border-b-[8px] border-red-900 active:border-b-0 active:translate-y-2 transition-all shadow-xl hover:brightness-110`.

Game_Over_Screen.strategy: Harsh, impact punctuation. `bg-black/90` backdrop blur over the canvas. Massive `font-impact` red text 'GAME OVER' centered.

Level_Transition.strategy: Sweeping screen wipe. Thick black bars closing in from top and bottom, or sliding in from the right.

Controls_Help_Overlay.strategy: Shadcn Dialog highly customized. `bg-background_surface border-2 border-border_color rounded-3xl p-8`. Looks like a rusty metal clipboard or a dark tech panel.
Controls_Help_Overlay.keys: KBD elements `px-3 py-1 bg-black rounded-md border-b-4 border-gray-700 text-white font-mono shadow-inner text-lg`.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly on HUD backing elements if needed (`backdrop-blur-md bg-black/30 rounded-full`).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Hard drop shadows for stickers (`drop-shadow-[0_4px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]`), diffuse ambient shadows for the canvas glow.
visual_enhancers.borders: Thick white borders on HUD items to simulate die-cut physical stickers.
visual_enhancers.motion: Bouncy hover states for buttons. Scale-in animations for HUD stickers on load. Shake animations on taking damage.

game_world_bg.description: Background image for the Title Screen or Wrapper background.

axel_character.description: Transparent PNG of Axel to be placed on the Title Screen layout.

hud_stickers.description: Collection of stickers. Can be used as decorative elements or cropped for actual HUD usage if needed.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white sticker text and icons have dark drop shadows to meet contrast over dynamic game canvas backgrounds.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the bouncing and pulse animations.
accessibility.testing: All buttons (Start, Restart, Controls) MUST have data-testid attributes like 'start-game-button'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application as a React SPA that simulates the game web wrapper. Use standard .js/.jsx extensions.
The root should have a full-screen background using 'game_world_bg' with a heavy dark blur overlay (`bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl`).
Center a main 16:9 container (`max-w-[1280px] aspect-video`) that acts as the 'Game Screen'.
Inside this container, implement state-based views: 'title', 'playing', 'level_transition', 'game_over'.
When 'playing', show a placeholder for the game itself (e.g. a dark animated background or the 'game_world_bg' slightly darkened) and render the HUD_Overlay on top.
The HUD must include Sticker Health (3 hearts), a Scrap Meter (progress bar), Coins counter, and a Power Timer (circular badge) positioned around the edges.
Implement the Start Game button with the thick 'clay/tactile' border-bottom style.
Use Phosphor icons heavily in the UI (Heart, Nut, Timer, Wrench, Coin) if standard SVG isn't used. Use the 'fill' weight for a chunky look.
For the Title Screen, use 'game_world_bg' as the container background and position 'axel_character' absolutely on the right side.
Add a 'Controls' button on the title screen that opens a customized Shadcn Dialog showing the keyboard mappings (WASD/Arrows to move, Space to jump, X to swing wrench).
